_source: Synthetic hard case: a climbing-partner finder that a reviewer could label 'dating' (the category-label pattern from the case law).
name: Belayer
subtitle: Find partners at your crag
description: Belayer helps climbers find a partner for tonight's session. Set your grades, home gym and the crags you climb, then swipe to match with climbers who need a belayer at the same time. Every profile shows verified belay certification from partner gyms, a lead/top-rope preference and the routes you have logged together. Plan a session, share the topo and check in when you are safely down.
differentiators: Belay certification verified through partner gyms
